baseline_ref.window: fixed: Cloudflare confidence >= 8 and seen by >= 25 route-collector peers, last seen within 72 h (BO-IND-11)

sources.descriptor: Cloudflare's automated detection on RouteViews, RIPE RIS and its own route collectors: origin hijacks with Cloudflare's confidence score and evidence, and provider-customer-provider leaks. It says what the collectors saw, not who meant it.
sources.title: Cloudflare Radar BGP hijack and route-leak detection

properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's hijack detection lists event 173095 at confidence 12 (Cloudflare's high band is 8 and above), first seen 2026-11-18T00:21:39Z, last seen 2026-11-19T03:04:31Z, by 35 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Prefixes: 23.230.219.0/24, 23.230.245.0/24, 50.118.136.0/24, 50.118.226.0/24, 82.22.61.0/24, 85.28.35.0/24 and more. Cloudflare's evidence: asrel new origin provider, irr new origin invalid, irr new origin valid, irr old origin invalid, rpki new origin invalid, rpki old origin invalid. Routing data alone doesn't tell a deliberate hijack (BO-H-4A) from an operator error (BO-H-4B) or a legitimate change the detector misreads (BO-H-4C). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.
